study type: Educational Intervention (Curriculum Evaluation) / Retrospective Pre-Post Test
outcome: Pediatric residents' knowledge of cancer survivorship
Pediatric residents' clinical skills in cancer survivorship care
Pediatric residents' attitudes towards cancer survivorship topics
Comfort in discussing topics relevant to survivorship care
cohort: Thirty-four pediatric residents at the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) completed the cancer survivorship curriculum and its evaluation.
finding: The implemented cancer survivorship curriculum significantly increased participating residents' knowledge, clinical skills, and comfort in discussing topics relevant to survivorship care.
